## 中文

- **Android 设备管理**：支持从账号设备列表移除 Host，并在本地清理对应凭据与工作区状态。
- **Antigravity ACP 稳定性**：改进取消后的进程恢复、思考过程流、工具完成状态和会话连续性。
- **Host 网关兼容性**：补齐未投影 Harness 页面在 Host 网关中的服务，保持远程工作区访问一致。

Plugin 与 Android 均为 **0.5.2**（Android `versionCode 41`）。iOS 客户端仍在内测招募中，欢迎通过 [iOS issue #20](https://github.com/liguobao/ds-harness-remote/issues/20) 报名和反馈。

## English

- **Android device management:** remove account-owned Hosts from the device list, with local cleanup of related credentials and workspace state.
- **Antigravity ACP stability:** improve cancellation recovery, thinking-stream capture, tool completion status, and session continuity.
- **Host gateway compatibility:** serve unprojected Harness surfaces through the Host gateway so remote workspace views remain available.

Upgrade both Plugin and Android to **0.5.2** (Android `versionCode 41`). The iOS client is currently collecting beta users and feedback through [iOS issue #20](https://github.com/liguobao/ds-harness-remote/issues/20).
